name: How long does an accessible bathroom remodel take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does an accessible bathroom remodel take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full accessible bathroom renovation typically takes two to four weeks once demolition begins. The overall timeline depends on the structural and layout changes required. Converting a fiberglass tub to a custom zero-threshold tile shower requires framing recessed subfloors, setting waterproof pans, and detailed tile setting. Widening doorways involves reframing wall studs, hanging new drywall, and custom trim carpentry. Owner Abraham Becerra oversees the work on-site, scheduling trade partners for rough-in plumbing and electrical inspections so finish drywall, tile, and paint proceed without unnecessary delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most accessible bathroom remodels take two to four weeks, depending on structural framing changes, plumbing relocations, and custom tile work.
